articles.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment

articles.title: A new framework for tokenized asset tracking
articles.snippet: None of the numbers most commonly used to assess tokenized assets answer the question a chief investment officer would ask about those assets on her own balance sheet: what is it doing for me?

articles.title: NYSE owner takes steps to bring Hyperliquid perpetual futures to U.S.
articles.snippet: The planned ICE[XYZ] venue would offer 24/7 perpetual futures on stocks, commodities and crypto, pending CFTC approval. ICE is investing in Trade[XYZ].

articles.title: Solana wallet Solflare pledges to pay missed rewards on staked $160 million after validator goes offline
articles.snippet: About 1.56 million SOL sat on a validator that stopped earning, and the wallet still hasn’t named the firm that held its keys.

articles.title: KuCoin suspends services in Russia and Belarus
articles.snippet: The exchange cited legal and regulatory compliance in its reason for cutting off services to users based in the two countries, currently the targets of international sanctions.
